options.name: clientIp
options.description: ClientIp query parameter. The IP of the client which the list of events will be filtered with. Only supported for track-by-IP networks.

options.name: clientMac
options.description: ClientMac query parameter. The MAC address of the client which the list of events will be filtered with. Only supported for track-by-MAC networks.

options.name: clientName
options.description: ClientName query parameter. The name, or partial name, of the client which the list of events will be filtered with.

options.name: deviceMac
options.description: DeviceMac query parameter. The MAC address of the Meraki device which the list of events will be filtered with.

options.name: deviceName
options.description: DeviceName query parameter. The name of the Meraki device which the list of events will be filtered with.

options.name: deviceSerial
options.description: DeviceSerial query parameter. The serial of the Meraki device which the list of events will be filtered with.

options.name: direction
options.description: direction (string), direction to paginate, either "next" (default) or "prev" page

options.name: endingBefore
options.description: EndingBefore query parameter. A token used by the server to indicate the end of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those. This parameter should not be defined by client applications. The link for the first, last, prev, or next page in the HTTP Link header should define it.

options.name: eventDetails
options.description: EventDetails query parameter. The details of the event(Catalyst device only) which the list of events will be filtered with.

options.name: eventSeverity
options.description: EventSeverity query parameter. The severity of the event(Catalyst device only) which the list of events will be filtered with.

options.name: excludedEventTypes
options.description: ExcludedEventTypes query parameter. A list of event types. The returned events will be filtered to exclude events with these types.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: includedEventTypes
options.description: IncludedEventTypes query parameter. A list of event types. The returned events will be filtered to only include events with these types.

options.name: isCatalyst
options.description: IsCatalyst query parameter. Boolean indicating that whether it is a Catalyst device. For Catalyst device, eventDetails and eventSeverity can be used to filter events.

options.name: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time
options.displayName: Meraki Action Batch Retry Wait Time
options.description: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time (integer), action batch concurrency error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_api_key
options.description: meraki_api_key (string), API key generated in dashboard; can also be set as an environment variable MERAKI_DASHBOARD_API_KEY

options.name: meraki_base_url
options.description: meraki_base_url (string), preceding all endpoint resources

options.name: meraki_be_geo_id
options.description: meraki_be_geo_id (string), optional partner identifier for API usage tracking; can also be set as an environment variable BE_GEO_ID

options.name: meraki_certificate_path
options.description: meraki_certificate_path (string), path for TLS/SSL certificate verification if behind local proxy

options.name: meraki_inherit_logging_config
options.description: meraki_inherit_logging_config (boolean), Inherits your own logger instance

options.name: meraki_log_file_prefix
options.description: meraki_log_file_prefix (string), log file name appended with date and timestamp

options.name: meraki_log_path
options.description: log_path (string), path to output log; by default, working directory of script if not specified

options.name: meraki_maximum_retries
options.description: meraki_maximum_retries (integer), retry up to this many times when encountering 429s or other server-side errors

options.name: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time
options.description: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time (integer), Nginx 429 retry wait time

options.name: meraki_output_log
options.description: meraki_output_log (boolean), create an output log file?

options.name: meraki_print_console
options.description: meraki_print_console (boolean), print logging output to console?

options.name: meraki_requests_proxy
options.description: meraki_requests_proxy (string), proxy server and port, if needed, for HTTPS

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error (boolean), retry if encountering other 4XX error (besides 429)?

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time (integer), other 4XX error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_simulate
options.description: meraki_simulate (boolean), simulate POST/PUT/DELETE calls to prevent changes?

options.name: meraki_single_request_timeout
options.description: meraki_single_request_timeout (integer), maximum number of seconds for each API call

options.name: meraki_suppress_logging
options.description: meraki_suppress_logging (boolean), disable all logging? you're on your own then!

options.name: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages
options.displayName: Meraki Use Iterator For Get Pages
options.description: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages (boolean), list* methods will return an iterator with each object instead of a complete list with all items

options.name: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit (boolean), retry if 429 rate limit error encountered?

options.name: networkId
options.description: NetworkId path parameter. Network ID.

options.name: perPage
options.description: PerPage query parameter. The number of entries per page returned. Acceptable range is 3 - 1000. Default is 10.

options.name: productType
options.description: ProductType query parameter. The product type to fetch events for. This parameter is required for networks with multiple device types. Valid types are wireless, appliance, switch, systemsManager, camera, cellularGateway, wirelessController, campusGateway, and secureConnect.

options.name: smDeviceMac
options.description: SmDeviceMac query parameter. The MAC address of the Systems Manager device which the list of events will be filtered with.

options.name: smDeviceName
options.description: SmDeviceName query parameter. The name of the Systems Manager device which the list of events will be filtered with.

options.name: startingAfter
options.description: StartingAfter query parameter. A token used by the server to indicate the start of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those. This parameter should not be defined by client applications. The link for the first, last, prev, or next page in the HTTP Link header should define it.

options.name: total_pages
options.description: total_pages(int), use with perPage to get total results up to total_pages*perPage; -1 for all pages
